DFC intends to invest in WIOCC
Signals U.S.-backed capital support; could lower funding costs and accelerate buildout.
Backed by AFC and Vision Invest
Validates platform with multi‑regional investors; de‑risks execution.
Capex to expand fibre, subsea and DC capacity can drive revenue scale.
Wide footprint enables faster monetization of added capacity.
Timing and size not final; deal risk remains until closing.

This is a mid-cycle validation of WIOCC’s growth plan, adding a prospective U.S. DFI alongside existing backers. A binding commitment, disclosed size/terms, and project milestones would turn this into a stronger catalyst.
